title: A failed payment suspends the organization and recovery reinstates it
description:
**Phase 3 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the webhook signature story
- **Runs in parallel with:** the enablement story
- **Unblocks:** nothing

---
The rest of the subscription lifecycle, mapped onto the status enum that already exists. Suspended is already a state the members CLI can set and reinstate from, and payment failure is simply another reason to reach it.

One thing to get right: suspension is not deletion. Their computer stops and the workplace locks, but the organization, its bots, and its channels survive — because most suspensions are an expired card, and a customer who loses their workspace over a card expiry does not come back.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Feature: Paid enablement

  Scenario: A final failed payment suspends the organization
    Given an enabled organization
    When Stripe reports the final payment attempt failed
    Then the organization status is suspended

  Scenario: An earlier retry does not suspend
    Given an enabled organization
    When Stripe reports a payment attempt failed with retries remaining
    Then the organization status is enabled

  Scenario: Recovering payment reinstates the organization
    Given a suspended organization whose payment failed
    When Stripe reports the payment succeeded
    Then the organization status is enabled
    And its bots and channels are unchanged
